raw_review_excerpt:
The plan is factually grounded and freeze-ready. Every load-bearing claim was verified against the actual codebase: the bundled-skill drift (codex-workflow-status.md missing from 26-file manifest), the test gap (skill.test.ts only asserts .claude writes), the sync skill's missing protected paths, and the SKILL.md routing table reference to the missing file. Exit criteria are measurable, verify commands are realistic and use actual repo tooling, and the phasing respects dependencies. Two minor tightening issues found (cp -R semantics and git-repo assumption for ~/.codex), neither of which blocks implementation.

Issues:
- 1. [WARN] cp -R destination semantics in P3-T1
- 2. [NOTE] P4-T1 git commands assume ~/.codex is a git repo without precheck

issues.title: cp -R destination semantics in P3-T1
issues.details: The command `cp -R .agents/skills/archon /Users/mase/.codex/skills/archon` behaves differently on BSD cp depending on whether the destination already exists. If it exists, BSD cp nests the source as a subdirectory (archon/archon). The plan's 'stop and diff' gate prevents the dangerous case, but the command itself is fragile if the guard is ever skipped.
issues.suggested_fix: Use `cp -R .agents/skills/archon/. /Users/mase/.codex/skills/archon/` or `rsync -a --delete .agents/skills/archon/ /Users/mase/.codex/skills/archon/` as the canonical copy command in P3-T1.

issues.title: P4-T1 git commands assume ~/.codex is a git repo without precheck
issues.details: Phase 4 checklist commands run `git -C /Users/mase/.codex log` and `git -C /Users/mase/.codex status` without `|| true` fallback. Phase 0 correctly uses `|| true` on the log command, but the Phase 4 checklist (which becomes the ongoing operating procedure) does not. If ~/.codex is not a git repo, these commands fail and block the checklist.
issues.suggested_fix: Add `|| echo 'not a git repo'` or a `test -d /Users/mase/.codex/.git &&` guard to the P4-T1 git commands, matching the defensive style already used in P0-T3.
